rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Ensure strong font weights (600, 700) for Cairo Arabic headings for optimal legibility.

spacing_and_layout.rtl_support: CRITICAL: Use logical properties like ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start, text-end. For grids, ensure direct children only. The app relies on index.css .rtl and .ltr classes.

motion.entrance: Use framer-motion for fade-in-up staggering on Bento grids.
motion.buttons: Hover state must be a lighter hue of the active state. Do not rely on opacity alone.

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Sticky Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-white/90). Must contain LanguageSwitcher, DataLifeLogo, Navigation links (desktop visible), and Start Free Trial CTA button. Use z-50.

components.name: HeroSection
components.description: Split layout or centered authoritative structure targeting ERP buyers. Left/Start: Narrative copy targeting efficiency (CTA: Start Free Trial & Login). Right/End: High-quality dashboard visual (feature_analytics image). Max overlay bg-white/30. No full-screen gradients.

components.name: AdSenseBanner
components.description: Reusable horizontal slot for Google AdSense placement to be used between major sections. Add data-testid='adsense-banner'.

components.name: FeaturesBentoGrid
components.description: A dense 'Control Room' Bento Grid (Mode B). Highlight modules: HR Management, Financial Management, Invoicing (ETA support), Purchases, Projects & Tasks, Analytics, Approvals, Import Data. Hover lift effect, 1px borders, white backgrounds on gray-50 section base. Icons for each module. Must use h-full for children.

components.name: BenefitsGrid
components.description: 4-column icon-based grid: 1) Arabic/English Support, 2) Cloud-based, 3) High Security, 4) Notifications. Soft rounded icons, minimal borders, clear text.

components.name: Testimonials
components.description: Social proof 3-column grid featuring professionals praising the ERP. Use testimonial images provided.

components.name: FAQAccordion
components.description: Using Shadcn Accordion. Minimalist styling, #28376B primary color used sparingly on active/hover.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Dark footer (bg-[#0f172a]) contrasting the light body. Large logo, deep padding (py-24), containing quick links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure RTL language switching handles Tailwind logical margins/padding (e.g. ps-4 instead of pl-4) so the layout flips seamlessly for Arabic.
Reuse the FreeTrialModal, PricingSection, ContactSection, DataLifeLogo, CompanyLogo, LanguageSwitcher components from the existing codebase.
Include an <AdSenseBanner /> placeholder component between major sections.
Bento grid for features must not stretch jaggedly - use h-full to make children match height.
Avoid generic 'Inter' for English headings, use 'Outfit' or 'Cabinet Grotesk' if possible, or fallback to system sans with tight tracking.
Never use a fully transparent header over hero images. Use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70 or bg-white/90.
All interactive elements and key info MUST include data-testid attribute.
